summary: We developed a cat space game to help children learn about resource management and solving problems about making colony in space. This game contains multiple choice quizzes that can help children know what to do to solve problems about resource management  and the problems happen in space.
details: This project helps children to learn about resource management like energy, water and oxygen management in space. This game can help children solve questions and learn about resource management while having fun. This game also helps children remember what they learned from the in game quizzes for a long time. This project use NASA informations, Wikipedia, Canva, Abacus AI and W3Schools to develop this project. Our project team took into a count and implemented team spirit, the vision of our tasks, our working hours and our organizational structure. Our team thinks that the project we develop is pretty creative because it contains good quizzes, significantly great solutions for resource management and a creative designs.
